title.en: Batas Pambansa Blg. 382  An Act Converting the Bitoon Barangay High School in the Municipality of Dumanjug, Province of Cebu, Into a National Vocational High School to Be Known as the Bitoon National Vocational High School.
title.orig: Batas Pambansa Blg. 382  An Act Converting the Bitoon Barangay High School in the Municipality of Dumanjug, Province of Cebu, Into a National Vocational High School to Be Known as the Bitoon National Vocational High School.
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trường Trung học Bitoon Barangay tại Thị trấn Dumanjug, Tỉnh Cebu thành Trường Trung học Dạy nghề Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Dạy nghề Bitoon Quốc gia
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bitoon Barangay ในเทศบาล Dumanjug จังหวัด Cebu เป็น โรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาอาชีวศึกษาแห่งชาติในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาอาชีวศึกษา Bitoon แห่งชาติ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sekolah Menengah Bitoon Barangay di Kotamadya Dumanjug, Provinsi Cebu menjadi Sekolah Menengah Kejuruan Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Kejuruan Bitoon Nasional
title.ms: Akta menukar status Sekolah Menengah Bitoon Barangay di Perbandaran Dumanjug, Wilayah Cebu kepada Sekolah Menengah Vokasional Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Vokasional Bitoon Kebangsaan

text.en:
The Bitoon Barangay High School in the Municipality of Dumanjug, Province of Cebu, is
converted into a national vocational high school to be known as the Bitoon National Vocational High School.

The amount of one hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be funded out of
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 131 and Batas Pambansa Blg. 230 for the Ministry of
Education, Culture and Sports intended for new national high schools: Provided, That the local government
unit concerned shall continue to provide funding for its share in the cost of maintenance and operation of the
school. Thereafter, such sum as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the
annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 8, 1983
